description: A man in his mid-fifties with a deep, dry, velvety baritone and a subtle continental European accent, somewhere between French and Italian. Slow, deadpan, theatrical timing; amused and knowing, like a legendary film director who finds everything slightly funny. Warm low resonance, crisp consonants, intimate close-mic studio recording.
text: Quiet on set. This candle has never been filmed. Watch the light crawl across the glass, slowly, like it is remembering summer. One take. No cuts. Then we roll.
